meta.title: Over-Ordering Config: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and repeat as a Buyer on the same Enterprise tenant.
Locate and exercise Over-Ordering Config to award beyond the requested quantity within tolerance.
Compare whether the action is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available to the Buyer.
Verify or set the tenant's Enterprise plan.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and repeat as a Buyer on the same Enterprise tenant.; Locate and exercise Over-Ordering Config to award beyond the requested quantity within tolerance.; Compare whether the action is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available to the Buyer.; Verify or set the tenant's Enterprise plan.

steps.note: Reach a prepared event with bids so the awarding flow is available.
Open the closest available awarding screen before the role-specific and Over-Ordering Config checks.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and the Buyer on the same Enterprise tenant, locate Over-Ordering Config, attempt awarding beyond the requested quantity within tolerance for each role, and record whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog has no step for alternate-role sessions, tenant-plan verification, or the Over-Ordering Config control.
Assert that the prepared awarding screen remains usable after the tester's role-specific investigation.
